column1: # mapping_set_description: Property correspondences applied by dcat_to_cdif.py (DCAT JSON-LD -> CDIF core/discovery).
#   Structural transforms the converter performs that are not term-to-term
#   mappings (so they have no TSV row):
#   - A CDIF catalog record is ADDED; dcterms:conformsTo is derived from content by detect_conformance (spatial/temporal presence upgrades core -> discovery).
#   - Unmapped DCAT properties are preserved verbatim (open world).
